author: official
summary: Fills sitetile collection cards with a repository’s last push date and archived state.

attributes.name: data-owner
attributes.description: GitHub owner whose repository cards are updated; must match ^[\w.-]{1,100}$.

attributes.name: data-api-base
attributes.description: Origin serving the repo-facts worker; must start with https://.

attributes.name: data-locale
attributes.description: Language override; otherwise page HTML lang, then en. Output languages are en, zh, ja, ko; unsupported languages use en.
